summary: Frontend-only verification of /wallet page fixes on The Dev Store (13 wallets). Verified: (1) horizontal overflow eliminated at 1920/1280/768/390 in BOTH light and dark themes (scrollWidth == innerWidth everywhere, zero offenders, wallet-total-hero scrollWidth == clientWidth); (2) all 13 wallet addresses render MASKED by default in first-8 + '…' + last-6 format with data-revealed='false'; (3) reveal eye button toggles per-card only (revealing wallet 1 and 2 did NOT reveal the other 11 - others remained data-revealed='false'); (4) aria-pressed flips false<->true correctly; (5) copy button copies FULL address both while masked and while revealed (clipboard content matches revealed full address exactly for BTC and ETH addresses); (6) data-copied flips to 'true' then reverts to 'false' after ~1.5s; (7) NO success toast appears on copy; (8) mobile 390x844 shows addr/eye/copy on one row (addr r=255, eye l=263 r=307, copy l=315 r=359, iw=390) with no clipping or overlap; (9) Regression: hero shows $29,951.98 + Active 13/Supported 15/Coverage 87%, page-tip-wallet visible on first visit, no console errors, /dashboard and /transactions load with scrollWidth==innerWidth==1920. Read-only mode respected (no clicks on Add/Edit/Delete/Manage).
